objects.name: Bronze
objects.note: REAL, degrees Celsius; starts at 21.5; Present_Value COV-subscribable (F-COV canonical example)

objects.name: Flax
objects.note: Present_Value is BACnetAuthenticationFactor (a 4-byte simple-number32 card ID, served via the OctetString callback - format-type/class default to 0 stack-side); Supported_Formats and Update_Time are REQUIRED (cl. 12.36) but not yet listed in the stack's property-profile-reference.md for this object type (a documentation gap, not a capability gap - both are served: Supported_Formats via RegisterCallbackGetPropertyAuthenticationFactorFormat, Update_Time via the existing Time callback wrapped into BACnetTimeStamp). Present_Value COV-subscribable (F-COV canonical example); the up/down keys simulate a new card presentation

objects.name: Vermilion
objects.note: BACnet/IP; Network_Type and Protocol_Level are set from BACnetStack_AddNetworkPortObject()'s arguments (IPv4, BACnet Application) at start-up, not a GetProperty callback like the object's other app-served rows; Changes_Pending is likewise computed and answered natively by the stack's Network Port object. Reliability has no fault condition this example detects, so it is accepted at the generic default (normal)
